result.topic_en: Continuation of a note on a sequence v_m: a value of k when 3m^2+6 is a perfect square, a formula for k via an equation involving square roots, examples of chains of equal values v_m = v_{2m} = ... , and (struck through) asymptotic comparisons of v_989 and v_1351 showing the irregularity of v_m.
result.transcription:
Add Ms a 94^{18 (14)} (14)
It can also be shown that, if $3m^2+6$ is a perfect square
(13). then $k = \sqrt{(3m^2+6)} - 1$
The actual value of $k$ can be got from (8) and (9). Thus
(14) $k = \left[\frac{x}{m}\right]$
where $\frac{\frac{x+1}{2} - \sqrt{\left(\frac{x^2-1}{12}\right)}}{x} = \frac{\left[\frac{m+1}{2} - \sqrt{\left(\frac{m^2-1}{12}\right)}\right]}{m}$.
Thus for example we have
$v_5 = v_{10} = v_{15} = \cdots\cdots = v_{40}$
$v_9 = v_{18} = v_{27} = \cdots\cdots = v_{45}$
$v_{14} = v_{28} = v_{42} = \cdots\cdots = v_{168}$
$v_{19} = v_{38} = v_{57} = \cdots\cdots = v_{608}$
$v_{71} = v_{142} = v_{213} = \cdots\cdots = v_{8662}$
$v_{265} = v_{530} = v_{795} = \cdots\cdots = v_{121670}$
$v_{989} = v_{1978} = v_{2967} = \cdots\cdots = v_{1693168}$
and so on. [-The irregularity of $v_m$ can also be seen
from the following example
$v_{989} = \frac{1}{6\sqrt{3}} - \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\cdot\frac{(1978+571\sqrt{3})}{(1713+989\sqrt{3})^2}\cdot\frac{1}{989^3}$
$= \frac{1}{6\sqrt{3}} - \frac{3}{2.10^{13}}$ nearly.
while
$v_{1351} = \frac{1}{6\sqrt{3}} - $ [-$\frac{3}{2702(2340+1351\sqrt{3})}$-]
$= \frac{1}{6\sqrt{3}} - \frac{1}{4.10^6}$ nearly.-]

methods.what: Value of k when 3m^2+6 is a perfect square
General formula for k as the integer part of x/m, with x defined by an equation involving the integer part of an expression in m
Examples of chains of equal values of v at multiples of m
Exact expression and approximation for v_989 (struck through)
